## Tarea 2. Protective Put [MATRICULA REDACTADA]

## Detalles de las Posiciones

```{r}
shares <- 100
entry_price <- 335.72
strike_price <- 335.00
put_price <- 4.05

# Rango de precios de AAPL al vencimiento

future_price_range <- seq(from = 0, to = 600, by = 1)
```

## Análisis de ganancia/pérdida

```{r}
# Ganancia o pérdida de las 100 acciones

long_stock_profit <- 
  (future_price_range - entry_price) * shares


# Ganancia o pérdida de la Put comprada

put_buyer_profit <- 
  (pmax(strike_price - future_price_range, 0) - put_price) * shares


# Ganancia o pérdida total del Protective Put

protective_put <- 
  long_stock_profit + put_buyer_profit
```

## Indicadores de la estrategia
```{r}
# Punto de equilibrio

breakeven <- entry_price + put_price


# Pérdida máxima

max_loss <- 
  (strike_price - entry_price - put_price) * shares


breakeven
max_loss
```

## Gráfica Protective Put

```{r}
# Configuración de la gráfica

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 8.1))

y_min <- min(c(
  protective_put,
  long_stock_profit,
  put_buyer_profit
))

y_max <- max(c(
  protective_put,
  long_stock_profit,
  put_buyer_profit
))

y_pad <- 0.08 * (y_max - y_min)


# Gráfica del Protective Put

plot(
  x = future_price_range,
  y = protective_put,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  main = paste0(
    "Protective Put AAPL (S0 = ",
    entry_price,
    ", K = ",
    strike_price,
    ", Put = ",
    put_price,
    ")"
  ),
  xlab = "Precio de AAPL al vencimiento (ST)",
  ylab = "Ganancia / Pérdida total (USD)",
  ylim = c(
    y_min - y_pad,
    y_max + y_pad
  )
)

# Línea de las acciones

lines(
  x = future_price_range,
  y = long_stock_profit,
  col = "blue",
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)


# Línea de la Put

lines(
  x = future_price_range,
  y = put_buyer_profit,
  col = "red",
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)

# Línea del strike

abline(
  v = strike_price,
  col = "lightgray",
  lty = 2
)


# Línea del punto de equilibrio

abline(
  v = breakeven,
  col = "darkgreen",
  lty = 3
)


# Línea de cero

abline(
  h = 0,
  col = "lightgray",
  lty = 2
)


# Línea de pérdida máxima

abline(
  h = max_loss,
  col = "purple",
  lty = 3
)

# Etiqueta del strike

text(
  x = strike_price,
  y = y_max,
  labels = paste0(
    "K = ",
    strike_price
  ),
  pos = 4,
  col = "gray30",
  cex = 0.9
)


# Etiqueta del break-even

text(
  x = breakeven,
  y = y_max * 0.92,
  labels = paste0(
    "Break-even = ",
    round(breakeven, 2)
  ),
  pos = 4,
  col = "darkgreen",
  cex = 0.9
)


# Etiqueta de pérdida máxima

text(
  x = min(future_price_range) + 20,
  y = max_loss,
  labels = paste0(
    "Pérdida máx = ",
    round(max_loss, 0),
    " USD"
  ),
  pos = 4,
  col = "purple",
  cex = 0.9
)

legend(
  "topright",
  inset = c(-0.35, 0),
  legend = c(
    "Portafolio (Protective Put)",
    "Acción (Long 100)",
    "Put (Long 1 contrato)"
  ),
  lty = c(1, 2, 2),
  lwd = c(2, 2, 2),
  col = c(
    "black",
    "blue",
    "red"
  ),
  title = "Componente",
  box.lty = 0,
  xpd = TRUE
)
```
